e2e.environment: dedicated resident audit Chrome via CDP 9333 (persistent profile, reused across runs); chrome-ensure reuse; one tab opened and closed; no temp Chrome/profile

modeLabel: 3–5 人 · 联机 + AI 补位 / 单人 AI

online.transport: HTTP/JSON + 700ms polling; server-authoritative; LAN-only by default

features.rooms: 3–5 seats; room id + 6-char code + single-use invite token
features.invite: inviteUrl uses the request Host; opens /boardgame/no-thanks-premium/online.html?room=&code=
features.stateSync: stateVersion + lastAction; every viewer receives the same public view
features.aiFill: empty seats fill to 3 players (up to 5) with the same engine and AI decision function
features.reconnect: session token + POST /api/rooms/:id/reconnect; reconnect clears timeout takeover
features.timeoutTakeover: no session request for 15s → server AI plays the seat; reconnect restores it
features.leaderboard: GET /api/leaderboard?game=no-thanks-premium; AI participants included; raw playerId hashed
features.idempotency: per-player idempotencyKey cached before the turn guard

evidence.runAll: test-online.js is auto-discovered by node games/tests/run-all.js

shared.shuffle: games/shared/shuffle.js — engine.js require + index.html script tag; seeded Fisher-Yates
shared.sfx: games/shared/sfx.js — index.html script tag; no per-game AudioContext
shared.rules: N/A — No Thanks rules live in engine.js
shared.leaderboard: shared room server keeps an anonymous in-memory board; no leaderboard copy

rules.scoring: each consecutive run counts only its lowest card; subtract one point per chip
